name: Siswa mengerjakan latihan sampai hasil (pilih bab)

planSteps.description: Verify the practice chooser appears (heading 'Pilih latihan.') listing the chapter 'Menemukan gagasan utama' with a 'Kerjakan' link, and no quiz question is shown yet
Click the 'Menemukan gagasan utama' chapter row to open its quiz
Verify the quiz shows the label 'BAHASA INDONESIA' and a list of questions, each with radio options
Answer every question by selecting one radio option per question (the submit button stays disabled until all questions are answered)
Click the button 'Kirim jawaban' and wait for the result page to load
Verify the URL becomes /siswa/latihan/hasil and the page displays a score number plus the line 'Jawaban benar: X dari Y soal'
